text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 19: Without a calendar baseline, the fitted solar capacity of the 25 BMUs is 161 to 323 MW at every assumed battery size tried, far below the solar study's 1,089 to 1,163 MW'
text.tspan: Figure 19: Without a calendar baseline, the fitted solar capacity of the
25 BMUs is 161 to 323 MW at every assumed battery size tried, far below

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Sum over the 25 aggregate BMUs of the fitted AC capacity of the four fleet curves (regional CAMS sky), with a battery of the assumed power and 2 hours of energy. The dashed lines are the solar study's totals over the same 25 BMUs; its method also fitted a seasonal calendar baseline, so the comparison shows scale, not agreement. No ground truth exists. The horizontal axis is stretched near 0.'

truth exists. The horizontal axis is stretched near 0.
